mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = true LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_address ( user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, is_default = #{isDefault}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user_address SET is_default = false, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = true
UPDATE user_address SET is_default = true, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
